name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Anders and Dasari, one goes with Algae and the other with Diatoms.
Beacon, Cortex, and Helix go with Algae, Diatoms, and Plankton, in some order.
Either Diatoms goes with Beacon or Helix goes with Algae.
The colonist studying Plankton's distance is higher than both Okafor and the colonist in the Beacon module.
Either Helix goes with 8 ly or Dasari goes with 8 ly.
Exactly two of these are true: Dasari goes with 11 ly; Fontaine goes with Helix; Algae goes with 10 ly.
